verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll, benefits and business-finance platform that is expanding into banking, so a buyer comparing business spend tools could fairly ask about travel management, and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows travel booking, rate monitoring or automatic rebooking. The banking, Money Dashboard, MCP, CLI and webhook items cover other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have booked travel rates automatically monitored and rebooked when prices drop
